searchText: Might have out of date info, but AFAIK, ELs would be happy to retain only WSP (assuming finalised). I don't think snap sync benefits from more than that. I believe retaining > WSP was driven only by perceived CL requirements and matching being a nice to have, but also not a requirement. Was discussed somewhere around this message... https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/953349957400821860/1497182377577807935 WSP isn’t a static value though, els need to rely on cls for that value which feels like a weird interaction perhaps that was why it was increased to the worst case WSP value then. Is that 33_024 epochs? https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/953349957400821860/1538276281169346672
